## Services

- Full-app audit — 5 business days — full app. Deliverables: cold and warm launch breakdown, top five jank hotspots with traces, memory peak and leak inventory, prioritized optimization backlog, written report, 60-minute walkthrough, one revision.
- Single-flow audit — 3 business days — one core flow, same measurement discipline and written report.
- Architecture review — 10 business days — layering and dependency-direction review, modularization and SPM split proposal, dependency injection and test strategy, phased migration roadmap and risk register, one revision.
- Ongoing contract — minimum 15 hours per week, billed weekly — embedded feature delivery, performance escalations, and App Store submission support.

Pricing for every service, fixed fees and the weekly rate alike, is listed only on https://hhfa008.github.io/ios/ and is not repeated here.

Terms for fixed-scope work: one revision and one 60-minute walkthrough included; 50% at kickoff, 50% on delivery; quotes valid 30 days; mutual NDA on request. What the client provides: read-only repository access or a buildable archive, plus the flow and device class where the problem appears.

## App Store review services (separate from the performance audit)

- App Store Readiness Check — 48 hours.
- Rejection Rescue — from 72 hours after materials arrive.
- Full Launch Support — 1–2 weeks.

These cover App Store review blockers. Rejection Rescue and the full-app performance audit are different scopes and are not interchangeable. Terms are on the App Store rescue page; current engagement pricing is on https://hhfa008.github.io/ios/.

## Templates (self-serve downloads)

- Self-serve templates from https://devinspire734.gumroad.com, catalog and prices on https://hhfa008.github.io/store/. They are instant downloads and include no consulting time.

## Employment track record

- Live SDK consolidation at ByteDance — led a three-year consolidation of two parallel iOS live SDKs into one shared codebase of 2M+ lines, with roughly 90% lower maintenance cost and zero high-severity incidents.
- 2022 World Cup live delivery — client-side lead coordinating 30+ iOS engineers across 32 live matches, with zero major incidents.
- Live SDK build and integration — reworked the build graph and SDK packaging, cutting full compile time from 50 to 10 minutes and host-app integration from 5 days to 1.
- Wealth-management app from zero — built the Swift architecture and component framework for a 2.2M-user platform, then cut code by 70% through componentization.

## Case studies

- OOM and memory on a top short-video platform — problem, actions, measurement method, and result.
- First screen for a live-streaming platform — problem, actions, metric definition, and result.
- 720p at 30fps on a live-streaming platform — problem, actions, per-overlay GPU cost, and result.

- The three case studies are employment track record, not paid consulting engagements. Client names, internal system names, absolute OOM baselines, sample sizes, and exact measurement windows are withheld under confidentiality.
- Every engagement is remote and priced in USD. Fixed-scope work starts with a scoping call and a fixed quote; replies within one business day.
